name: Security & Supply-Chain Governance Profile
description: Dual-layer defense: OWASP secure-by-default development and Trail of Bits deep vulnerability audit

optional_specialists.trigger: Agent skills, MCP tools, plugins, or third-party package additions
PostgreSQL database permission and Row Level Security (RLS) policies
Electron or Tauri desktop IPC security isolation

routing_flow: 1. Architecture Understanding: Map system components, entry points, and trust boundaries
2. Threat Modeling: Identify high-risk triggers (auth, PII, payments, crypto, IPC)
3. Secure-by-Default Implementation: OWASP guidelines for input validation and defenses
4. Static Analysis: Automated and semantic code scanning for known vulnerability patterns
5. Variant Analysis: Search for systemic instances of discovered vulnerabilities
6. False-Positive Validation: Weed out non-exploitable findings with proof-of-concept tests
7. Supply-Chain Review: Verify licenses, scan third-party packages, and pin integrity hashes
release_gate: Zero unmitigated High or Critical static analysis findings
All external inputs are strictly sanitized and schema-validated
Authentication endpoints enforce rate limiting and constant-time comparison
No plain-text credentials, tokens, or private keys in source control
Database access enforces least-privilege roles and parameterized queries
Supply chain scan passes with all dependencies pinned to verifiable hashes
